authority: Author EXEC — Implement approved Food Wheel evidence-ledger reconciliation, 9 November 2026
scope: Relationship-specific qualified PM-network publication through the written evidence ledger only. Existing ordinary-food projection and ranking holds remain. No canonical admission or SEC changes.

relationships.observed_endpoints: Aged female mice, sixteen-week high-fat diet with the tested high-amylose RS2 material: lower serum/faecal LPS and increased colonic mucin.
relationships.limitations_and_nulls: No human efficacy or ordinary-food equivalence; preserve null colon histology/length and cytokine findings. The 20% dietary material is not 20% pure RS2.

relationships.observed_endpoints: Orafti Synergi 1, 1% w/v drinking water during four weeks of Western-diet feeding in mice: preserved mucus penetrability.
relationships.limitations_and_nulls: Not mucus growth or thickness improvement. Combined treatment did not retain the inulin-alone penetrability benefit. Exact batch composition not verified; no generic inulin or food equivalence.

relationships.observed_endpoints: Exact NCC2705 strain in mouse drinking water: preserved mucus growth.
relationships.limitations_and_nulls: Not penetrability or thickness improvement. No species/genus efficacy inheritance, food occurrence, human translation or ordinary-food dose.

relationships.observed_endpoints: Exact JB-1 strain: mouse GABA receptor-transcript and behavioural findings with vagal dependence.
relationships.limitations_and_nulls: Preserve the healthy-human trial null for mood, anxiety/stress, sleep, HPA/inflammatory and cognitive outcomes. No generic probiotic efficacy. Exact mouse administered dose remains unverified.

relationships.observed_endpoints: Studied apple-pectin exposures in cultures and mice: altered microbial tryptophan-metabolite partitioning.
relationships.limitations_and_nulls: Preserve culture reagent versus mouse diet distinctions, below-detection ILA/IPA in FMT, nonsignificant faecal tryptophan change and no serum tryptophan difference. No whole-apple equivalence or human neurotransmitter benefit.
